layout.name: Simple Line Chart
layout.layoutData:
<# var msg = tw.resource.toolkit.TWSYS.ChartMessages; #>

chart {
	antiAliasing : "true";
	antiAliasingText : "true";
	backgroundPaint : "#ffffffff";
	border : "@#border12";
	header : "@#label9";
	legendPosition : "Absolute";
	legendVisible : "true";
	name : "<#= msg.getChartDefString("chart.SimpleLine.name") #>";
	opaque : "true";
	preferredSize : "600,250";
	renderingType : "COMBO";
	sampleSeries[0] : "<#= msg.getChartDefString("chart.SimpleLine.lineSet1.text") #>,35,35,35,35,35:LINE";
	sampleSeries[1] : "<#= msg.getChartDefString("chart.SimpleLine.lineSet2.text") #>,20,30,45,30,40:LINE";
	type : "CARTESIAN";
	XGridVisible : "false";
	YGridVisible : "true";
}

chartGrid {
	fill : "true";
	majorPaint : "#FFedf2f6";
	majorStroke : "@=stroke8";
}

chartLegend {
	antiAliasing : "true";
	antiAliasingText : "true";
	border : "@#border11";
	followChartResize : "true";
	font : "SansSerif,12";
	foreground : "dimgrey";
	location : "75,35";
	paintingBackground : "false";
}

chartScale[axisIndex="-1"] {
	autoDataRange : "true";
	foreground : "#ff000000";
	labelColor : "#ff000000";
	labelFont : "SansSerif-10";
	labelRotation : "0";
	majorTickVisible : "true";
	title : "<#= msg.getChartDefString("chart.SimpleLine.bottomAxis.title") #>";
	titleColor : "#ff000000";
	titleRotation : "-0.0";
}

chartScale[axisIndex="-1"] axis {
	autoVisibleRange : "true";
}



chartScale[axisIndex="0"] {
	autoDataRange : "true";
	foreground : "#FF4580b4";
	labelColor : "#FF4580b4";
	labelFont : "SansSerif-10";
	labelFormat : "@+format7";
	labelRotation : "0";
	majorTickVisible : "true";
	title : "<#= msg.getChartDefString("chart.SimpleLine.leftAxis.title") #>";
	titleColor : "#FF4580b4";
	titleRotation : "-90.0";
}

chartScale[axisIndex="0"] axis {
	autoVisibleRange : "true";
}



series[index="0"] {
	color1 : "#ffff0000";
	color2 : "#ffff0000";
	marker : "CIRCLE";
	markerSize : "7";
	renderingType : "POLYLINE";
	stroke : "@#stroke1";
}

series[index="1"] {
	color1 : "@=color3";
	color2 : "#ff0000ff";
	marker : "CIRCLE";
	markerSize : "7";
	renderingType : "AREA";
	stroke : "@#stroke2";
}

Subobject#border10 {
	bottom : "2";
	class : "javax.swing.border.EmptyBorder(top,left,bottom,right)";
	left : "2";
	right : "2";
	top : "2";
}

Subobject#border11 {
	bottom : "1";
	class : "javax.swing.border.EmptyBorder(top,left,bottom,right)";
	left : "1";
	right : "1";
	top : "1";
}

Subobject#border12 {
	bottom : "1";
	class : "javax.swing.border.EmptyBorder(top,left,bottom,right)";
	left : "1";
	right : "1";
	top : "1";
}

Subobject#border5 {
	bottom : "2";
	class : "javax.swing.border.EmptyBorder(top,left,bottom,right)";
	left : "2";
	right : "2";
	top : "2";
}

Subobject#color3 {
	adapting : "true";
	class : "ilog.views.util.java2d.IlvLinearGradientPaint(start,end,stops,colors,spreadMethod,colorSpace,transform,adapting)";
	colors[0] : "#99C5DFF4";
	colors[1] : "#99C5DFF4";
	colorSpace : "SRGB";
	end : "0.5,0.0";
	spreadMethod : "PAD";
	start : "0.5,1.0";
	stops[0] : "0.0";
	stops[1] : "1.0";
}


Subobject#format7 {
	class : "com.lombardisoftware.core.chart.jviews.IlvNumberFormat(type, pattern)";
	pattern : "%,d";
	type : "INTEGER";
}

Subobject#label4 {
	border : "@#border5";
	class : "ilog.views.chart.swing.IlvJLabel";
	font : "SansSerif-16";
	foreground : "#ff000000";
	horizontalAlignment : "0";
	text : "<#= msg.getChartDefString("chart.SimpleLine.header") #>";
}

Subobject#label9 {
	border : "@#border10";
	class : "ilog.views.chart.swing.IlvJLabel";
	font : "SansSerif-16";
	foreground : "#ff000000";
	horizontalAlignment : "0";
	text : "<#= msg.getChartDefString("chart.SimpleLine.header") #>";
}

Subobject#stroke1 {
	class : "java.awt.BasicStroke(lineWidth,endCap,lineJoin,miterLimit,dashArray,dashPhase)";
	dashPhase : "0.0";
	endCap : "0";
	lineJoin : "2";
	lineWidth : "1";
	miterLimit : "3.732051";
}

Subobject#stroke2 {
	class : "java.awt.BasicStroke(lineWidth,endCap,lineJoin,miterLimit,dashArray,dashPhase)";
	dashPhase : "0.0";
	endCap : "0";
	lineJoin : "2";
	lineWidth : "1";
	miterLimit : "3.732051";
}

Subobject#stroke8 {
	class : "java.awt.BasicStroke(lineWidth,endCap,lineJoin,miterLimit,dashArray,dashPhase)";
	dashPhase : "0.0";
	endCap : "0";
	lineJoin : "2";
	lineWidth : "1";
	miterLimit : "3.732051";
}
